(4) Where the chief executive officer of the
Corporation  is  informed  that  any  person  is
contravening the provisions of subsection (1)
he shall take all appropriate measures to prevent
such  person  from  carrying  on  the  unlawful
activity, and may where necessary, obtain the
assistance of the officer-in-charge of the Police
Station  within  whose  area  of  authority  the
extent of land or any part thereof in which the
alleged unlawful activity is being carried on, is
situated.  It  shall  be  the  duty  of  such  Police
Officer  to  provide  all  necessary  assistance  to
the  chief  executive  officer  or  any  officer  or
servant  authorized  in  that  behalf  by  the  chief
executive  officer,  to  prevent  such  person,  his
